evaluated_by: D68 repair by the single owner (Claude agent), 2026-10-10/11 UTC; not an independent review
pass_condition: Intervention, controls, falsifier, metrics, leakage, and statistics specified
protocol: K-Dense experimental-design and statistical-power (vendored): design before data (a 2x2 blocked by task and session, seeded interleaving, episodes split across both certified harnesses); power by simulation of the registered estimator on measured inputs (a beta-binomial propensity model fitted on S1a's cells and checked against them) and by exact noncentral-t computation; K-Dense statistical-analysis and the ARS statistical reporting standards for paired, clustered inference, TOST and the rare-break bound
evidence: Intervention (application catalog x layout switch, isolated catalogs), controls (en baseline; O1-O6 with positive controls; functional and config probes; step-0 and keyboard checks), falsifiers P1-P7 and kill criteria K0-K6, primary estimand D with a three-way decision and the rare-break bound, design before data on measured inputs: a propensity model fitted on S1a's cells and checked against them, and a simulation of the registered estimator over six effect structures (PRESENT at -5 pp: 0.89-0.97 for a uniform logit shift, 0.09-0.21 for complete breaks; null false PRESENT <= 0.053; unqualified false SMALL <= 0.038). Disclosed limits: break-type effects are underpowered at this K, and an unqualified SMALL needs about 43 tasks (compute/repair-d68/power-osworld.json; superseded runs power-osworld-v0-partial.json and power-osworld-v1-break050.json kept).
remediation: Build Phase 0 and run its gate as a cpu-doctor node; add tasks (a full-pool extension) if break-type effects must be detectable
disclosed_limits: a 5 pp mean effect made of complete breaks in a few percent of tasks is detected with probability 0.09-0.21 at K = 26-43
an unqualified SMALL is impossible at K = 26-31 and becomes realistic only near K = 43
the propensity model and the effect structures are assumptions anchored on S1a's English records; no localized-cell data exist
the oracle thresholds are calibrated on Chromium fixtures only; Phase 0 recalibrates them by A/A on the derived image
